location: 矮人矿山 · 熔炉盆地
note: 熔炉盆地的工人,只有闲聊台词。

messages.raw: §fThese forges have been running at an endermite's pace!
messages.text: These forges have been running at an endermite's pace!
messages.gloss: endermite 用《我的世界》官方中文译名“末影螨”。
messages.zh: 这些熔炉慢得像只末影螨!

messages.raw: §fMy job here is to make sure the lava flows and that the titanium shines.
messages.text: My job here is to make sure the lava flows and that the titanium shines.
messages.gloss: Titanium 已确定译“钛”,见 GLOSSARY.md。
messages.zh: 我在这儿的活儿,就是保证岩浆一直流、钛一直亮。

messages.raw: §fYep, it's mostly watching other people work!
messages.text: Yep, it's mostly watching other people work!
messages.zh: 是啊,基本上就是看别人干活!
